subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

They catch whale sharks commercially in some places around the world.

options.text: Whale sharks are caught commercially in some places around the world.
Whale sharks are being caught commercially in some places around the world.
Whale sharks were caught commercially in some places around the world.
Whale sharks have been caught commercially in some places around the world.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Whale sharks are caught commercially in some places around the world**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V1 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (Objective Case) + is/am/are + V3 + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice) 
 
 

 
• *Example:*

 
 
• *Aastha teaches English. (Active Voice) *
 
• *English is taught by Aastha. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'They'. 
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'Whale'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'catch' will be changed into 'are caught'.

 

Correct Sentence:__* Whale sharks are caught commercially in some places around the world.*
